methodologyDescription.spin: Asks about Situation, Problem, Implication and Need-payoff to help the prospect feel the value of solving their problem.
methodologyDescription.bant: Qualifies on Budget, Authority, Need and Timeline to quickly decide if a lead is worth pursuing.
methodologyDescription.meddic: Qualifies complex deals via Metrics, Economic buyer, Decision criteria, Decision process, Identified pain and Champion.
methodologyDescription.challenger: Teaches the prospect something new, tailors the message and takes control of the conversation to reframe how they think.
methodologyDescription.sandler: Up-front contracts, uncovers pain and budget, and lets the prospect sell themselves while avoiding pushy tactics.
methodologyDescription.custom: No fixed framework. The agent follows only your script and instructions.

frequencyDescription.objectionsOnly: Stays quiet until the prospect objects, asks something or shows interest.
frequencyDescription.balanced: Reacts to everything meaningful the prospect says, plus occasional nudges.
frequencyDescription.constant: Always shows the next best line. Great for new reps and practice.

typeDescription.microphone: A call on your phone's speaker or another device. CallZen listens through this device's microphone. Best for cold calls.
typeDescription.onlineMeeting: Google Meet, Zoom, Teams or any web meeting. You share the meeting tab's audio so both sides are captured separately.
typeDescription.upload: Already have a recording? Upload an mp3, m4a or wav file and get the same transcript and performance report.

roleDescription.owner: Full control. Can change role permissions, delete the organisation and manage every member. Always has every permission.
roleDescription.admin: Runs the team day to day: manages co-pilots, members and invitations within the permissions the owner grants.
roleDescription.member: Sells and practices. Sees only their own calls unless the owner grants more.

1.label: Very easy
1.description: Friendly and open, almost no objections.

2.label: Easy
2.description: Open, a couple of mild objections, converts readily.

3.label: Medium
3.description: Some skepticism and genuine objections. Needs good discovery.

4.label: Hard
4.description: Guarded and busy, tough repeated objections, may hang up early.

5.label: Very hard
5.description: Hostile to sales calls. Converts only with excellent technique.

temperatureDescription.cold: Never heard of you, no expressed interest, possibly busy or annoyed at being called.
temperatureDescription.warm: Has shown interest or had prior contact, and is more open to talking.

planDescription.trial: Try everything with a small allowance.
planDescription.pro: For serious individuals who practise and call a lot.
planDescription.coach: For coaches and their students, with pooled minutes and coaching tools.

cancelReason.temporary: Only needed it for a while

feature.agentAccessControl: Per-student access to co-pilots and prospects

analysisHint.categoryScores: Score per skill and the skills trend
analysisHint.moments: Timeline-linked mistakes and strengths, recurring mistakes
analysisHint.improvements: What to do better next time
analysisHint.metrics: Talk ratio, pace, fillers, interruptions, objections
analysisHint.practiceReveal: The hidden persona details after a practice session
analysisHint.copilotUsage: How the co-pilot's suggestions were used
